why: In each quarter of the inner square there is only one line from the centre to the corner. So the missing quarter has a small square with just one slanting line from the centre to its outer corner, plus the two rings. Option 2 fits. Options 1 and 3 have a full X, and option 4 has an extra line.
trick: For a missing piece, copy the pattern of the other pieces exactly; extra lines make an option wrong.
